name: Angel of the Prism

start.dialog: There's something in the Prism... calling to me. I feel it when I sleep. Wings. Angel wings. Made of crystal. Help me find what I'm seeing?
start.objective: Search the Prism for the source of Rinoa's crystal wing visions

progress.dialog: It's getting stronger... this way! I can feel it pulling me!
progress.objective: Follow the psychic pull to the source

complete.dialog: There! The Crystal Angel statue! It was calling me... showing me what's possible. Thank you. Here - my Shooting Star. It's helped me before. Now let it help you.

party_comments.kade: She really did feel something. These crystals are strange.
party_comments.renna: Psychic resonance with Light Foundation. Similar to my own.
party_comments.nix7: Anomalous readings near subject. Energy spike detected.

hidden_outcome: If you find the statue during a full moon, Rinoa awakens her 'Angel Wing' form temporarily and gives you 'Wings of the Goddess'
